name: PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk engages in the wholesale trading of computers and computer equipment. It operates through Hardware and Maintenance segments. The company offers IT managed services, such as asset management, datacenter management, desktop management, service desk, and network management; and various hardware and software supporting traditional infrastructure, including servers, storage, PC, network devices, operating system, security, etc., as well as converged infrastructure and hyper-converged infrastructure.
